localeReason: English and Simplified Chinese are genuinely useful for Chinese-speaking Berlin arrivals maintaining China contact, understanding passport-channel uncertainty and distinguishing app calls, +86 calls and EU roaming. The original profile and conditional eligibility remain unchanged.

planningAssumptions.profile: Mei, 29, Chinese-passport data analyst with Blue Card status, Friedrichshain Berlin job starting 2027-03-01, two WFH days, evening streaming and weekly China family calls. Anmeldung around day 14, bank account weeks 2–3 are assumed timetable, not eligibility findings.
planningAssumptions.billingBasis: Home billed on activation and monthly firsts, no prorating; fees within horizon. Arrival/activation dates not supplied facts or installation guarantees.

commonMobile.voucherLimit: Denominations may require more cash and leave balance; do not double-count first ALDI package.

scenarios.condition: Existing usable apartment fibre, compatible network equipment and advertised standard-development waiver; no nonstandard works.
Same bridge retained for comparability even if earlier activation avoids it; residential address restriction and indoor reception untested.

o2Conflict.limit: Indexed shop versus landing page conflicts; no universal quote or maximum. General price-list and AGB endpoints unread; no claim relies on them.

homespotFlex.limit: Conditional equipment/reserve model, not a confirmed Flex quote. Check equipment cancellation separately.

planningAssumptions.exclusions: Existing unlocked tethering phone, electricity/Ethernet, paid office/coworking, TV/streaming, nonstandard works, moving, deposits, premium services and +86 telephone calls. No separate router purchase or cashback/porting/young-person discount. App-to-app calls have assumed no incremental telephone fee, not zero data cost; office access must be arranged.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: README and VOICE-GUIDE read first; batch33 Penang JSON and English Markdown read for schema/voice only. Complete assigned index.html, sources.md, independent-check.md and research-home/mobile/rules.md read. Final corrected index and ledger supersede stale draft claims; no other run folder or network research. content_utils.py and bounded check_i18n.py source inspected; no build or inventory changes.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original automatic existing-browser and browser-backed search fallbacks lacked established clean state, including failed reviewer fallback. No substantive claim relies on their empty/error results; historical all-clean-session requirement cannot be certified. Later clean contexts do not cure that exception.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Original independent arithmetic passed conditional inputs, with director closure correcting assumed arrival, stale price-list explanation and narrow-source eID caveat. O2/Flex reconciliation, actual address/approval/ID/device facts and China telephone rates remain open. Original reviewer did not independently certify pixels; author-owned source layout observation is not certification of new Markdown.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: No new HTML build, browser, pixel or print certification. Source screenshots are visual artifacts, not necessary evidence for this Markdown rewrite.

datePolicy: All 27 source read/attempt dates are explicitly 2026-11-07 in the assigned ledger and retained unchanged. Authoring is not a refresh. March 2027 offers, address and personal acceptance remain unknown.
uncertainties: No specific-address availability, free DSL port, ready cable/FTTH, measured performance, indoor signal or employer VPN test.
O2 landing/indexed offer conflicts, hardware-fee waiver, fibre development variants and conditional Flex equipment/cancellation unresolved; scenarios not quotes or upper bounds.
March 2027 tariffs/allowances, applicant credit/payment/document approval and household/newcomer promotional eligibility unverified.
Exact Chinese passport/channel acceptance, eSIM regional phone compatibility and usable electronic residence eID/PIN/NFC unconfirmed; branch route is not guaranteed.
Current China fixed/mobile telephone rates, connection charges, rounding and bundle eligibility unverified and excluded. App calling is recommendation, not service guarantee.
Residential cable and 5G delivery deadlines unverified; installation buffers are planning allowances, not Berlin averages or promises. Nonstandard works unquoted.
Original clean-session requirement not certifiable; no historical compliance or new visual certification claimed.
editingContract: Only assigned new data JSON, English/Chinese Markdown and checks/batch34-berlin-author-note.md. No build, inventory or existing-file edits, networking or publication.
